title: Strategic roadmap checklist and stakeholder rotation plan for quarterly exec readouts
creator: Marisol Ortega
description: Purpose: Create a repeatable, lightweight playbook and checklist for monthly/quarterly roadmap readouts that reduces prep time, distributes presenter responsibility across tribes, and ensures consistent decision artifacts for execs and the board. This work bundles a one-page checklist, a rotating presenter calendar, slide & appendix templates, a pre-read data snapshot query, and a short runbook for handling follow-up asks. Scope: PM-led templates and process, one Confluence page, one Google Slides deck, a small set of SQL/Look and/or dashboard queries for signal sections, and a 6-week pilot with two product tribes. Out of scope: full auto-generated readouts from telemetry or changes to existing OKR tooling integrations (these are follow-ups).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Confluence playbook created with editable checklist and presenter rotation table. 2) Slide deck template with slots for signals, product health, risks, asks, and contingency lanes. 3) Data snapshot queries and a short instructions doc that a PM can run in <20 minutes to fill the signals slide. 4) Pilot run executed with two tribes and feedback captured. 5) Exec stakeholder feedback indicates reduced prep friction (qualitative) and at least one decision documented per readout.
success_metrics:
- Pilot adoption: 2 tribes complete pilot within 6 weeks.
- Prep time reduction: median PM prep time drops by 30% vs previous readouts (self-reported).
- Meeting outcomes: >=1 documented decision or clear next-step per readout.
- Template reuse: at least 3 distinct PMs reuse templates in the quarter.
deliverables:
- Confluence playbook page (editable).
- Google Slides deck template with appendix and data snapshot slide.
- SQL/Look queries and instructions (copiable snippet).
- Presenter rotation calendar (Google Calendar share + owner doc).
- Pilot feedback notes and action tracker.
